alt: A row of values folded into rows of the block size, one row per block. Each block's sum is filled in one block at a time, and the last block is shorter when the length does not divide evenly. The presets use eight values and six values.

steps.caption: 8 values, so the block size is `b` = 3, the smallest number whose square reaches 8. Each row of the table is one block of up to 3 positions. The sums are not computed yet.
`sums[2]` is the total of positions 6-7: 2 + 6 = 8. This last block has only 2 values, so it is shorter.
Done: 3 sums for 8 values. Position `i` lives in block `i // 3`, so position 7 is in block 2. Adding all the sums gives 31, the total of every value.
6 values, so the block size is `b` = 3, the smallest number whose square reaches 6. Each row of the table is one block of up to 3 positions. The sums are not computed yet.
Done: 2 sums for 6 values. Position `i` lives in block `i // 3`, so position 5 is in block 1. Adding all the sums gives 23, the total of every value.
